cold_email.subject: Interest in BDR - Canada - University Graduates (AH-P) (P) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear HubSpot Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the BDR - Canada - University Graduates (AH-P) (P) opportunity with HubSpot at HubSpot.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.description: Career Category Operations Job Description The Commercial Analytics team at Amgen serves as a strategic partner to Commercial leadership. It delivers rigorous analyses and data-driven insights that drive US commercial performance. This role is part of Amgen's growing analytics capability in India. It works closely with US-based Commercial and Global Customer Capabilities Innovation teams to advance how artificial intelligence is applied to insight generation and decision-making across the enterprise. As Commercial Analytics Manager for AI Innovation & Enablement, you will be accountable for defining and executing the team's AI strategy across the commercial portfolio. You will partner with the leadership to set priorities, govern the delivery of AI solutions, and ensure that each capability creates measurable business value while meeting the highest standards of quality and compliance. You will guide the work of Senior Associates and analysts and act as the primary point of contact for cross-functional AI partnerships. The role requires deep commercial analytics expertise, technical fluency in AI, sound judgment, and the ability to lead change without direct authority. Live | What you will do 1. AI Strategy, Roadmap & Portfolio Prioritization Define and maintain the team's AI roadmap in partnership with the Leadership team, aligning initiatives with US commercial priorities and enterprise AI direction. Identify, assess and prioritize cross-portfolio AI use cases based on business value, feasibility, data readiness and risk. Translate US business questions into structured AI solution approaches with clear objectives, success criteria and value measures. Assess emerging AI technologies, platforms and industry practices, and recommend which to adopt and where. 2. STAKEHOLDER RELATIONSHIPS AND ROLE BOUNDARIES Connects study-level MDR work with project or molecule governance. The Lead Medical Data Reviewer aligns with Medical Monitors and Clinical Scientists, provides integrated MDR evidence, and ensures technical consistency. The role preserves the Medical Monitor’s accountable medical oversight and the Clinical Scientist’s assigned study-science responsibilities. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE · MD/Diploma with 3-5 years of relevant experience · MBBS from an MCI/NMC-recognized medical institution in India 5-8 years of relevant experience · Substantial relevant experience in clinical development, medical data review, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance, or comparable clinical-data work. · Demonstrated responsibility for complex MDR delivery across multiple studies, a molecule, project, or program. · Evidence of cross-study clinical judgment, integrated risk synthesis, and influence in senior cross-functional forums. · Experience improving review quality, analytics, tools, processes, or capability without relying on formal authority. · Technology application knowledge with AI Literacy in Clinical Development Space The role is senior-manager-equivalent in scope as an expert individual contributor; final GCF placement depends on sustained molecule/project accountability, complexity, influence, and competency evidence rather than qualification alone. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE · Therapeutic-area depth in complex, early-development, registrational, or submission-critical programs. · Experience shaping cross-study IDRP strategy, Medical Monitoring Plan medical-interpretation inputs, integrated review, Spotfire, programmed checks, or governed AI requirements. · Broad understanding of the clinical-development value chain from protocol strategy through submission and evidence generation. · Experience supporting process or capability governance and sustained adoption of new practices. · Demonstrated technical mentoring of experienced reviewers or study-responsible MDRs. · Knowledge of AI Literacy and its ethical applications in Clinical Development .

cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Lead Medical Data Reviewer opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Sr Associate Quality Control — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Sr Associate Quality Control opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. cold_email.subject: Interest in Graduate Opportunity: Business Development Representative — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear HubSpot Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Graduate Opportunity: Business Development Representative opportunity with HubSpot at HubSpot.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. ROLE OVERVIEW As Harvey scales its post-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager - Product Specialist to lead and grow the Product Specialist team in Munich. This role was created to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Product Specialists who support existing customers in maximising their use of the Harvey platform. Harvey’s Legal Engineer - Product Specialists are experienced lawyers from top-tier firms who leverage their legal expertise to help customers seamlessly integrate Harvey into their daily workflows - driving adoption, increasing utilisation, and supporting long-term expansion and renewal. Legal Engineer - Product Specialists collaborate closely with Harvey’s Customer Success Managers to drive all facets of the post-sales strategy. They develop consultative relationships with law firm partners, associates, innovation teams, and in-house counsel, serving as trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can enhance legal effectiveness and efficiency. Legal Engineer - Product Specialists draw on their legal training and practice experience to ask thoughtful questions, uncover adoption barriers, and develop tailored strategies that build credibility with customers. They partner with Customer Success Managers to communicate Harvey’s value through a mix of large group sessions, small workshops, and one-on-one conversations. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Lead and develop a team of Legal Engineers - Product Specialists in the DACH region, providing coaching, performance management, and career development support. - Own the post-implementation customer relationship from a legal engineering perspective, ensuring law firm and in-house clients are effectively onboarded, trained, and supported on an ongoing basis - Act as the senior escalation point for complex or strategic customer engagements, bringing deep product and legal expertise - Partner with Account Management and Sales to identify expansion opportunities, support renewals, and contribute to retention strategy - Collaborate with the Product team to surface customer feedback, advocate for platform improvements, and keep the team informed of new features and roadmap developments - Define and iterate on team processes, playbooks, and frameworks to build a scalable and high-performing function WHAT YOU HAVE - Qualified lawyer with 7+ PQE, with experience in a law firm or in-house legal environment - Prior experience managing or mentoring a team, with a track record of developing talent and driving performance - Deep familiarity with legal technology and AI tools, with an ability to quickly develop and demonstrate platform expertise - Strong commercial instincts and the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders at law firms and in-house legal teams - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience running training, workshops, or client-facing product sessions - Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach DEPENDING ON YOUR LOCATION, AN APPLICANT PRIVACY NOTICE MAY APPLY TO YOU. cold_email.subject: Interest in Legal Operations Associate — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Dropbox Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Legal Operations Associate opportunity with Dropbox at Dropbox.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

You will be accountable for the global operations management of critical mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and control systems. As a subject matter expert in data center infrastructure and operations, you will develop scalable processes for execution, help manage data center partners & vendors, lead deployment schedules, and maintain close coordination with related disciplines such as design, engineering, and capacity planning. Create standards for monitoring data center systems operation, minimizing risk, and effectively responding to/managing excursions and incidents. Develop innovative approaches to improve time to market and equipment availability while minimizing cost and complexity. Enable scale-out of operations through industry best practices optimization of bill of materials, logistics, and physical processes. Manage partner relationships and maintain alignment with Anthropic goals. You may be a good fit if you: Have 10+ years of experience in data center facility operations as a manager, engineer, technical lead or related role. Bachelor's degree in relevant domain or equivalent practical experience. It's a bonus if you have: 15+ years of experience managing operations for large scale data centers. An understanding of AI/ML workloads, including power, cooling, and network connectivity Experience supporting technology cooling solutions such as rear door heat exchangers and/or cooling distribution units, Experience managing third-party datacenters such as colo operators and/or contract staffing vendors. Familiarity with data center facilities commissioning processes including developing commissioning plans, creating criteria, and conducting hand-over reviews Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
